items.html: And indeed, before her upper ten Sefirot were revealed in her, they were all included in his ten Sefirot. Hence, in each and every Sefira of the ten Sefirot of ZA, there is in it the aspect of one Sefira of the Nukva, but it is only her tenth part alone, namely her Sefira of Malchut. And the growth of Malchut is not at one time, but over many times she is corrected and grows little by little, as above.
